reforms.description: The federal government provides cash grants totaling $350 million a year to encourage exploration and development by mostly small and medium-sized oil and gas companies in Western Canada, estimated to generate $1 billion of extra investment and 15,000 jobs.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The grants are expected to stimulate investment and job creation in the oil and gas sector, enhancing economic activity.
reforms.status_evidence: The government has allocated the funds for the grants.
reforms.importance_rationale: The grants represent a significant financial commitment to support the oil and gas sector, which is crucial for the regional economy.
reforms.source_quote: Federal Government provides cash grants totalling $350 million a year to encourage exploration and development by mostly small and medium-sized oil and gas companies in Western Canada.
